label: D1 after a rewarded rare transition from a2 (a2 -> S1 rewarded)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (zero at GO/D2), and almost only when the reward input is 1 (98% of mass). The strongest case is the previous trial being a2 that reached S1 by a rare transition and was rewarded, which is the canonical model-based switch cue. On dev: precision 0.81, recall 0.49, mass recall 0.77; it covers 90% of the top activation quartile. All conditions are observed (the previous trial plus the current reward input). Magnitude is larger when the trial before that was also rewarded (adding that condition gives precision 0.99). Weaker activations (about 0.1-0.4 of max) come from rewarded-S1 streaks reached via a1 (common) and from other rewarded D1s. It essentially never fires after unrewarded trials. Activity is also confined to model value below about 7.7 and choice logits between about -9 and 3. Rate is higher at rel +1 only because of the core-pattern sampling (rare-rewarded cores). Adding streak clauses did not improve F1.
